inner_per_outer_fit.layer_selection: rank all 30 layers by selection AUC only
inner_per_outer_fit.top5_ensemble: unweighted mean of predictions from top 5 selection-AUC layers

probe.best_weights: deep-copied state at best early-stop AUC
probe.note: This implements the released probe architecture and intended best-weight early stopping while avoiding state_dict reference aliasing.

bootstrap.primary_pairing: same resampled row indices for compared scores

scale_gate.caller_auc: caller top5 OOF AUC >= zsigmoid AUC + 0.015
scale_gate.caller_tpr_01: caller top5 TPR@1% FPR >= zsigmoid TPR@1% FPR + 0.01 absolute
scale_gate.caller_unique_tp: caller top5 adds >= 10 conservative unique true positives versus zsigmoid at 1% FPR

helper_language_specific.comparison: helper top5 versus caller top5 within each language
helper_language_specific.bootstrap: paired resampling stratified by label within that language
helper_language_specific.survives_definition: at least one language has AUC-delta 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
helper_language_specific.reason: This operationalizes the previously frozen qualitative phrase 'reproducible language-specific gain that survives outer OOF and paired bootstrap' before the 1000-row cache is executed.
